description: Eastbound Tunnel and Bridge Traffic Monthly Volume, Port Authority of NY NJ: Beginning 2011 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. The Port Authority collects eastbound vehicle traffic volumes from its toll plazas at the six Port Authority vehicular crossings (i.e., George Washington Bridge, Holland Tunnel, Lincoln Tunnel, Goethals Bridge, Outerbridge Crossing and Bayonne Bridge). Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are port authority, vehicles, bridges, traffic, tunnels. The table has 5 columns. Attribution on the portal: The Port Authority of NY & NJ. The portal shows 2016-10-11 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
